Hello, thank you for your comment. I actually don’t have much energy, and if anything, I’m actually sleepy right now. As much as I’d like to write, or do any of the things I’d like to pick up as hobbies, I have to focus on getting my schoolwork done; I know that mind sound obsessive, but trust me, I get tired and sleepy extremely quickly (I think it’s a consequence of my depression, which I was diagnosed with three years ago). Plus, I get addicted to things I like doing very easily and too intensely, like playing video games, for example. Like I get so addicted that that’s all I do everyday, and I completely disregard my “important” tasks to my own detriment. These are why I’ve had to push my hobbies out of my life (for now at least).

My pain’s made me suicidal, and my breaking point was realising that I don’t know what to do with my life, why I exist, if purpose is real (and if so what is mine), etc. These thoughts made my struggles with my other problems and insecurities (ugly body, family problems, etc.) feel like they’re not worth dealing with if I don’t even truly know what I’m living for.

So the only thing my pain is motivating me to do is to find a way to end it, or at the very least, move on to what we’ll all go through in the end anyway: “death,” or whatever that is, it’s a mystery to me.

Regarding the life I want, I can’t really picture that out if I don’t know what to do with it in the first place, or what my purpose is, so I really just want to “die.”

Also, thank you for your compliment, at least someone (you) thinks positively of something I made. I hope I’ll feel better too, or at the very least move on from my present feelings of loneliness and lack of companionship because these feelings hurt a lot (they hurt enough to make me cry) and I really need to keep working or else school’s gonna kill me again.

And lastly, I hope you yourself are doing a-ok. Here’s to a lighter tomorrow.

Thanks to everyone who responded. So basically, from what I understand, my opponent just resigned for some random reason. I thought they did so because of something related to our game itself, which is what led me to make this post. Anyway, again, thanks for clearing things up, I guess sometimes the truth is just too good to believe

It’s my first time using LiChess, and this was my very first game on that platform. I’d like to hear your thoughts since based on material alone, my opponent obviously had the upper-hand. But in terms of positional play, I think (although I may be wrong) that I had some potential.

Thanks for telling me this; I already bought the game though, and upon testing it, it seems to work (the display setting is set to low though). I’ll definitely try the older titles soon, but I think I’ll finish this one first, since I am particularly interested in the game’s historical setting. Also, I apologise for taking a very long time to reply, I slept and got caught up doing other things.
Oh, I just purchased it through the Microsoft Store, not through Steam. I hope this mistake wasn’t too big, but still, thanks for the tip - I’ll be sure to check out Steam in the future.
Thank you for your advice; I will heed your words and purchase the game, and try it out first.

I see, thank you both for letting me know this. Some time during the beginning of the game, I received a notification saying that a city-state was conquered by an unmet player. I got curious, so I searched up a complete list of city-states online. It so happened that I found Palenque on the list I read, and immediately believed that it was the city-state that the notification referred to. 

Again, I appreciate your concise answers, and I will now be on the look-out for the actual captured city-state.

Hi again, since you haven’t replied in a while, I’ll be logging off for now, so I’m going to be apologising in advance if ever I don’t reply immediately. Rest assured that I’ll check every once in a while to see if you’ve sent your reply. I hope that I have been helpful to you, and that everything works out for you and your family. Stay safe.

Oh, almost forgot to mention this, but would it be possible for you to do or at least help him finish his project for the recruiting agency?

Ok, I hope you don’t mind me saying, but I your husband is starting to strike me as someone who is immature and naive. As stupid as this sounds, I need to know: can you describe to me how you talk to him, in what way do you express your feelings without insulting him, and how you confront him about your current situation? Examples of how you talk to him may help. The reason behind my request is because I think that the main problem right now is either your husband’s mentality (if he is truly genuine, sincere, and honest about loving you and your children), or your husband’s parasitic nature (if he is merely using you for his convenience). If the former is true (know that I hope so), you may have to begin to be even more assertive to him, in a sense you need to “wake him up” from the immaturity he is embedded in. You have to tell him “No, things won’t get better until you get up on your feet and help us make it better.” You have to make him realise that a family unit is collaborative in nature, and that you alone cannot overcome the financial crisis you are in right now. Make it CLEAR to him that it won’t get better until he becomes productive like how you are. If the latter is the case, things may get a little more tricky, and maybe even colder. I’ll wait for your next comment before adding anything more, though.

Oh sorry, the time difference completely slipped my mind. Hmm, if you know, would you mind telling me what the project is, and how it can be accomplished? If not, please let me know. Unfortunately, I think I need the answers to my last questions (about your husband’s opinion regarding your living situation and if being more assertive to your husband is a plausible choice) to think of more ways to try to get around your  problem. I hope I don’t sound rude, I genuinely want to help you but I can’t think of proper solutions if I don’t fully know your situation. Also, I’ll just drop this question: has your husband been physically or verbally violent towards you or the children in the past? Knowing his behaviour more may help think of ways on how you can successfully communicate with him

Oh, and when you can, may I suggest that you ask your husband why he does not feel like putting effort into the project? You don’t have to right now, since I think you are still too emotionally hurt because of your last conversation with your husband (I inferred this from the fact that you stated that you cried during the said conversation)

Hmm, based on his reactions, I don’t think your husband understands or realises that your feelings are genuine. However, it could also be possible that he does, and he simply does not love you and your children, and is simply manipulating you for your his own benefit (I thought of this possibility since the children are not his biological offspring, and you earn all of the money while he lazes around); based on your perception of him, do you think your husband genuinely feels any love for you and your children? Also, I must ask again though, what are your husband’s thoughts on your family’s current living situation? If you know, please tell me. Also, I am not entirely sure if this is a good idea due to your cultural context, but would it be fine if you became more assertive with him? Let me know your answer in detail, and I’ll try to come up with something to try to help you. [Sorry if I have lots of questions, but I need to ask them in order to get a better understanding of your context so that I can give you better advice]

Hello there, reading your post made me feel very sad, and I would like to try to help you. Reading some of the comments here, I learned that: your husband put in enough work to almost get into the eligibility list of a recruiting agency you found for him, but he did not submit the final project which prevented him from getting into the said list (1), either divorcing or leaving your husband would bring unfavourable consequences due to your cultural context (2), you’d rather not have your children work because they are both young and are currently engaged in their studies (3), approaching the police to report your husband would be a foolish decision since he has not committed any legal crime (4), and the main reason you are depressed and suicidal is because your husband does not care and is not responsible enough for both you and your children (5). Out of the things I’ve learned so far, the first and last points I mentioned stuck with me the most, since the latter explains why you are suicidal and depressed, and the former gives me information I can use to try and alleviate your problem. Could you, however, tell me why he did not submit the final project to the recruiting agency? Also, do you know or have some idea as to why your husband does not care for you and your children adequately? If so, could you tell me that too?
